title: Kestrel Auto Care | Sample Trade Website
description: A sample website for a local auto repair and detailing shop: before and after, services, reviews and an appointment request. A concept by Tava Valenti.
sample_notice: This is a sample website for a made-up auto repair and detailing shop, to show what a local business site can look like. Photos are AI-generated placeholders.
name: Kestrel Auto Care
hours: Mon to Fri 8 to 6, Sat 8 to 2
license: BAR auto repair license # shown here

hero.alt: A freshly detailed dark gray SUV in a clean auto shop bay at dusk
hero.sub: Brakes, maintenance and diagnostics, plus full detailing, from a family-owned shop in Oceanside. Straight answers and a price before we touch your car.

before_after.text: A sedan with dull paint, brake dust and foggy headlights, after a full exterior detail and headlight restoration. Drag the line to compare.
before_after.aria: Before and after of a blue sedan: dusty, spotted paint and cloudy headlights on the left, glossy paint and clear headlights on the right. Drag to compare.

services_head.text: One shop for the repairs that keep you safe and the detailing that makes the car feel new again.

services.alt: A mechanic replacing a brake rotor and caliper
services.title: Brakes & suspension
services.text: Pads, rotors, shocks and alignments, with the old parts shown to you.

services.alt: A mechanic checking an engine with a work light
services.title: Diagnostics & maintenance
services.text: Check-engine lights, oil changes and scheduled service, explained in plain words.

services.title: Full detail
services.text: Wash, clay, polish and protect, so the paint looks deep and stays clean longer.

services.alt: A spotless car interior with clean leather seats
services.title: Interior detailing
services.text: Seats, carpets and dash deep cleaned, stains lifted and smells gone.

services.alt: A car covered in foam during a hand wash
services.title: Hand wash & paint care
services.text: Gentle hand washes and wax or ceramic protection for daily drivers.

services.alt: A headlight half cloudy and half restored
services.title: Headlight restoration
services.text: Cloudy, yellow headlights made clear again, so you can see and be seen at night.

steps.text: No upselling and no surprise charges. We call you before doing anything that wasn't on the estimate.

items.title: Call or book online
items.text: Tell us what the car is doing, or what you'd like cleaned up. We'll find a time that works.

items.title: Inspection & written price
items.text: We check it over, show you what we found, and give you a price before any work starts.

items.title: Fixed, cleaned and ready
items.text: We text you when it's ready and walk you through what we did.

gallery.alt: Detailed SUV in the shop at dusk
gallery.caption: Full detail, SUV

items.quote: They showed me the worn brake pads and the price was exactly what they quoted. No pressure to add anything.

items.quote: My car is eight years old and it looks better than when I bought it. The headlights alone were worth it.
items.name: Maria S.

items.quote: Honest shop. They told me a repair could wait six months instead of selling it to me today.
items.name: Tom R.

about.alt: A mechanic's hands fitting a new brake caliper
about.text: Kestrel is a small family-owned shop in Oceanside. The same people who answer the phone work on your car, and we'll always explain what it needs and what can wait.

estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll call or text you back within one business day with a time.
estimate.placeholder: Year, make and model, and what it's doing (noises, warning lights)...
